CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT] AS
BEGIN

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)
, FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
,TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct
AS(
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
,* FROM (
SELECT 
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','TRY','DEP')  

UNION ALL

SELECT 
 DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND DDA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'  
GROUP BY
DDA.AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId
,DDP.ProductSK
,BCAFP.ProductID
,DDB.BankSK
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode 


UNION ALL

SELECT  DISTINCT
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BTTFP.FinancialProductId) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BTTFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode  --change from dimaccount
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                  
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTrade BTT
LEFT JOIN BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct BTTFP ON BTTFP.TradeId = BTT.TradeId AND BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = BTTFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON convert(varchar,BTT.CounterPartyId) = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BTT.SourceSystemCode AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BTT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BTTFP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = BTTFP.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BTTFP.FinancialProductId = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BankSK = DDB.BankSK  AND BTT.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode AND DDB.BankSK = DDP.BankSK
WHERE BTTFP.SourceSystemCode <> 'DEP' --FOR SEPARATE DEP FILTER

UNION ALL

--FOR DEP RECORDS FILTER
SELECT 
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                    
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP
JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
) A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL  THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'    
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimAccountProduct (
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,ProductSK
,ProductID
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm      )              
SELECT
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,ProductSK
,SRC.ProductID
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm  
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = SRC.ProductID AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
--Where sourcesystemcode is not null

END
GO
